definitions.explanation: The fluffy fiber from the cotton plant, or cotton as a material.
Soft material used to fill cushions, quilts, stuffed toys, etc.

examples.japanese: {綿|わた}⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦{雲|くも}→雲：02202_kumo⟧。
examples.english: Clouds as white as cotton wool.

examples.japanese: ⟦{枕|まくら}→枕：03898_makura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{綿|わた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦へたって→へたる：10679_hetaru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The stuffing in the pillow has gone flat.

⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{綿|わた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{直|なお}して⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。

notes:
{綿|わた} refers to both the raw cotton fiber and the processed material used as stuffing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{綿|めん}→綿：03807_men⟧100%: 100% cotton, on clothing labels (cotton fabric is read めん, not わた)
- {綿|わた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧ (to stuff with cotton)
- {綿|わた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to put cotton filling in)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{木綿|もめん}→木綿：01738_momen⟧ is another reading for cotton fabric/cloth
- ⟦コットン→コットン：30876_kotton⟧ is used mainly in fashion/cosmetics contexts
- ⟦{脱脂綿|だっしめん}→脱脂綿：30877_dasshimen⟧ is absorbent cotton (medical cotton)
